claims.claim: Prefill and Decode maintain separate sender/receiver queues and complete the KV handoff asynchronously.
claims.locator: Disaggregation prefill queue and transfer processing
claims.notes: The article diagram is a simplified state machine.

claims.claim: The default early allocation policy reserves Decode destination KV slots before Prefill completes.
claims.notes: Per-request reservation timing, not global KV pool creation.

claims.claim: prefill_complete delays Decode slot allocation until Prefill accepts its final result and signals readiness.
claims.notes: Not a general throughput improvement; it changes overlap and retention tradeoffs.

claims.claim: The prefill_complete implementation has explicit topology/backend restrictions and requires consistent policy and revision across communicating workers.
claims.notes: Restrictions are pinned to the cited source revision.

claims.claim: Abort, timeout, retraction and bootstrap-room cleanup participate in the transfer lifecycle.
claims.locator: Abort notification, deferred ACK, timeout and room lifecycle
claims.notes: Backend-specific behavior also exists in Mooncake and NIXL implementations.

claims.claim: TTFT can be decomposed into queue, Prefill, bootstrap, KV transfer, Decode admission and first Decode work.
claims.locator: Decode allocation policy and profiling guidance
claims.notes: Measurement decomposition; spans may overlap and should be evaluated on the critical path.
